violet: Link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2425000000. We need concise, owned follow-ups for the authz incident: token validation edgecases, permission rollbacks, audit re-ingest, secrets rotation automation. Please claim an item, add ETA, and a one-line smoke check for the runbook.

harry: I'll take token validation hardening (race on refresh, TTL mismatch across services). ETA: 2026-04-06. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_sync.py::test_ttl_consistency -q`

sylvia: I'll own audit re-ingest and schema validation for malformed payloads. Plan: small-staging replay for 48h gap, add DLQ for bad records. Backfill ETA: 2026-03-31, validator PR ETA: 2026-04-04. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName="Authenticate" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)`

ken: I'll handle permissions rollback and a CI check to ban wide binds in svc namespaces. ETA: 2026-04-08. Smoke: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name|test("svc-"))'`

violet: Who can own service-account secrets rotation + runbook automation? This needs HSM import help.

harry: I can coordinate rotation with infra for HSM import, but need an infra handoff. Plan: staging canary rotate, script automation, runbook snippet. Rotate ETA: 2026-04-02, runbook update by 2026-04-03. Smoke: `kubectl get secret sa-key -n default -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.createdAt}'`

tracker-bot: Created ticket SEC-1310: "AuthZ: postmortem follow-ups and closure". Claimed: token-hardening (harry), audit-reingest (sylvia), perms-rollback (ken), secrets-rotation (harry). Recurrence: weekly drift scan (cron: 0 9 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1310

violet: Consolidated closure checklist (update SEC-1310 as you make progress):

```
- [ ] Token validation hardening (race fixes + TTL unification) — owner: harry — due: 2026-04-06
- [ ] Audit re-ingest + schema validator (48h window) — owner: sylvia — due: 2026-03-31 (backfill) / 2026-04-04 (validator)
- [ ] Permissions rollback + CI guard to block broad binds — owner: ken — due: 2026-04-08
- [ ] Secrets rotation automation + runbook + HSM import help — owner: harry + infra — due: 2026-04-03
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert on TTL divergence >10s and missing Authenticate events) — owner: tracker-bot (SRE) — recurring weekly
```

harry: I'll add a one-line runbook smoke to the ticket after PR.

sylvia: Starting a small staging backfill now, will escalate in SEC-1310 if malformed rate >5%.

ken: Inventorying RBAC diffs, will post a minimal RBAC patch and CI job to prevent regressions.

violet: Note: this incident shows a recurring pattern around TTL drift after rolling deploys. Ops, please ensure the weekly drift check accounts for timezone/clock skew. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :thumbsup:
